provenance.notes: C (gcc, x86-64 SSE + libgcc soft-fp for _Float16) conversions float64->float32 and float64->_Float16 under fesetround(FE_TONEAREST, FE_TOWARDZERO, FE_UPWARD, FE_DOWNWARD), and float32 add/mul under each mode. Mode order: [nearest-even, toward-zero, toward-positive, toward-negative]. Results are raw binary32 / binary16 bit patterns (hex).
